title: Authorize legacy renderer deletion
summary: WP-M2-05 removes the legacy fallback branch from pages/review/[id].js and deletes the bespoke legacy review table components. This is destructive, so Codex needs explicit approval before touching those files. Current evidence: WP-M2-02 schema parity is green, WP-M2-03 confirms all 40 deals are card-backed with zero default legacy fallback, and CI schema-parity is required. Approval lets Codex open the deletion PR limited to the review renderer fallback and listed legacy components. Rejection keeps the fallback and components in place.
